description: Find who sponsors a newsletter, or which newsletters a brand sponsors, from public newsletter archives (Substack archive JSON, beehiiv and other sitemaps, RSS). mode newsletter: give newsletter_urls (for example notboring.co) and get one row per sponsor found in the newest issues, with sponsor name, domain, link without tracking, placements, share of issues, first and last issue seen, and issue links, plus one free summary row per newsletter. mode brand: give brand_name and brand_domain (for example Attio, attio.com) and get the newsletters whose recent issues carry a sponsor placement for the brand, found through Google results and confirmed in each newsletter's own issues. A placement is a short block with a sponsor label (presented by, brought to you by, sponsored by, together with) and the first outside link beside it. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per sponsor row and, in brand mode, one brand search event.

brand_domain.description: Brand mode. The sponsor domain, for example attio.com.

brand_name.description: Brand mode. The sponsor name as newsletters print it, for example Attio.

issues_to_scan.description: Newest issues read per newsletter, 1 to 200; at most 20 in brand mode. Default 20.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount.

mode.description: newsletter (default): newsletter links in, sponsors out. brand: a brand in, the newsletters that ran its placements out.

newsletter_urls.description: Newsletter mode. Home page links or domains, up to 100, for example notboring.co.

newsletters_to_check.description: Brand mode. Candidate newsletters to confirm, 1 to 10. Default 10.

since_days.description: Stop at issues older than this many days. 0: no limit. Default 365.

name: track_newsletter_sponsors
title: Track newsletter sponsors
